dialogues.label: Loot the treasure cache
dialogues.line: I pry open the cache and take what I can.
dialogues.responseText: You salvage useful supplies from the opened cache.

dialogues.label: Say: I wish something else was here
dialogues.line: I wish something else was here.
dialogues.responseText: You stare at the empty corner and note what has changed.

dialogues.label: Appraise the cache seals
dialogues.line: The lockwork tells a story if I read it closely.
dialogues.responseText: You map hidden mechanisms and extract cleaner salvage routes.

dialogues.label: Make a discipline oath
dialogues.line: No wasted motion. No wasted turns.
dialogues.responseText: You lock into a strict routine.

dialogues.label: Ask for a sparring drill
dialogues.line: Push me to the edge. I need real pressure.
dialogues.responseText: The drill is brutal but your rhythm sharpens.

dialogues.label: Ask about hidden routes
dialogues.line: Tell me what path you saw last.
dialogues.responseText: The reply gives you clues about nearby corridors.

dialogues.label: Trade rumors
dialogues.line: I heard movement near the forge. What did you hear?
dialogues.responseText: The conversation reshapes what both of you think is true.

dialogues.label: Direct interrogation
dialogues.line: Drop the story. Give me facts.
dialogues.responseText: You get sharper details, but the room temperature drops.

dialogues.label: Probe warden patrol pattern
dialogues.line: When does the Depth Warden switch rotations?
dialogues.responseText: You piece together patrol timings and mark a safer window.

dialogues.label: Guided breathing
dialogues.line: Inhale four counts. Hold. Exhale slow.
dialogues.responseText: Your pulse stabilizes and panic drains out.

dialogues.label: Tell a dark joke
dialogues.line: If we survive, this is still going in the stream highlight reel.
dialogues.responseText: Someone laughs. The tension breaks for a minute.

dialogues.label: Etch rune notes
dialogues.line: These symbols are a language; I need to keep the grammar.
dialogues.responseText: Your notes reveal consistent rune behavior patterns.

dialogues.label: Livestream the forge pulse
dialogues.line: Watch this, chat. The room is alive.
dialogues.responseText: The stream spikes as the forge reacts to your cadence.
